name: oberth
description: Oberth runs above the prompt (up to the runs option, three by default, none at 0), the /oberth-runs table and /oberth-watch completion notices for the person, and the connection skill; the model uses the oberth bridge's tools.

executable.title: Verified executable
executable.description: Absolute verified executable path printed by oberth join; blank uses the fetcher's install in the user bin directory.

profile.title: Uplink profile
profile.description: Joined profile name or up to 32 comma-separated names to merge across upstreams; blank uses OBERTH_PROFILE, then the joined checkout's profile.

runs.title: Runs shown
runs.description: How many runs the box above the prompt shows: a whole number from 0 to 10; blank is 3; 0 shows no box.
